text: Mutually exclusive with [Ode to Miraculous Magic]
Summons a unit of Durthu's Wargrove (Treekin).
The ancient Treemen possess immense magical power, granting a potent blessing to all who stand near them.
Durthu's comrades can summon Treekin from the forest to fight at their side when they are overwhelmed.
Wielding the forest itself as a weapon is a lesson every Wood Elf must learn.
As the Twilight Handmaidens roam the forest, they gather various resources along the way to replenish their equipment and restore their condition.
Naestra's blessing fills the Twilight Handmaidens with fervour, sharpening their sight to see further.
Arahan's blessing hardens the Twilight Handmaidens with coldness, keeping them ever vigilant and ready.
A special melody inspires allies fighting alongside it, making them unstoppable on the battlefield.
Wondrous music seems to hold a healing magic, soothing the wounds and fatigue of nearby warriors.
The Druid casts a spell that continually ensnares enemies in an illusory sea of flowers.
Transform into a beast to deliver a lethal blow to the enemy.
